dogecoin.text:
How Do Faucets Work?  

Faucets work by distributing tiny amounts of crypto (like Bitcoin, Ethereum, or Dogecoin) to users. These rewards are funded by ads or sponsorships. While the payouts are small, they can add up over time, especially if you claim regularly! 🕒
